items.title_zh: 芝加哥大学教授：AI 时代数学人才招聘将更看重研究愿景与表达能力
items.title_en: University of Chicago Professor: AI-Era Math Hiring Will Value Research Vision and Communication Skills More
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，人工智能正在降低数学研究取得突破的门槛，但这也意味着，学术界可能需要重新审视人才招聘方式。芝加哥大学一位知名数学教授认为，未来招聘数学研究人员时，个人交流能力和清晰表达研究构想的能力将变得更加重要。 芝加哥大学数学领域的杰出学者弗兰克 · 卡莱加里（Frank Calegari）近日在一篇文章中谈到了自己对研究人员的招聘标准。他写道：“我想了解你希望数学走向何方，也需要具备能解释这为何可能实现的专业能力。” 卡莱加里担忧，随着人工智能工具不断进步，学术界各个领域的初级研究岗位可能会被一些学生占据，而这些人之所以能够获得相关成果，可能只是因为他们大量使用人工智能生成证明。 不过，他认为，一场 30 分钟的面对面交流，就足以区分两类候选人：一类只是批量制造低质量研究成果的人，另一类则拥有清晰的研究愿景，并且善于表达。 卡莱加里在发布于陶哲轩（Terence Tao）博客上的文章中表示： “招聘流程将不得不更多地依赖人与人之间的直接交流，而不是仅仅审查书面材料。” 他还批评了一些他所称的“懒惰的评审委员会”，认为这些委员会过去仅凭一篇论文或一项学术成果就决定是否录用学生，而如今，这类成果完全可能由人工智能生成。 他表示：“一旦我们采取这种方式，就有责任培养自己的研究生，让他们具备更好的数学表达能力。我们本应更加认真地对待这件事。” 上个月，康奈尔大学教授史蒂文 · 斯特罗加茨（Steven Strogatz）也曾指出，具备“rizz”（俚语，意为个人魅力）特质的数学家如今更受重视，因为他们能够解释人工智能生成的研究结果，并以此提出新的数学问题。 IT之家注意到，人工智能公司迅速进军数学领域，已经让不少数学研究人员感到不安和困惑。随着 OpenAI 向这一领域大量推出针对世界上最复杂数学难题的解决方案，数量达到数百项，整个数学界都在思考如何在人工智能时代保持自身价值。 一些教授已经明确表示不再使用人工智能。不过，大多数人仍在尝试寻找将这项技术融入自身研究的方法。 美国各地的学生也在努力适应这一变化，并要求教授明确公布人工智能使用指南，说明学生是否可以使用这类工具，以及应该如何使用。 一名学生在麻省理工学院（MIT）近期开展的一项调查中写道：“整个学术界目前缺乏高层次的领导和指导。”
items.summary_en: AI is lowering the threshold for breakthroughs in mathematical research, but this may also mean academia needs to rethink how it recruits talent. Frank Calegari, a prominent mathematics scholar at the University of Chicago, believes that personal communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate a research vision will become more important when hiring mathematics researchers in the future. He wrote: 'I want to understand where you want mathematics to go, and I also need the expertise to explain why that is possible.' He worries that as AI tools improve, junior research positions across academia may be filled by students who obtain results largely by using AI extensively to generate proofs. However, he believes a 30-minute face-to-face conversation is enough to distinguish candidates who mass-produce low-quality research outputs from those with a clear research vision who are good at expressing it. In an article published on Terence Tao's blog, Calegari said the hiring process will have to rely more on direct person-to-person communication rather than merely reviewing written materials. He also criticized what he called 'lazy review committees' that in the past decided whether to hire a student based on a single paper or academic result, which today could be entirely generated by AI. He said: 'Once we adopt this approach, we have a responsibility to train our own graduate students so that they have better mathematical expression skills. We should have taken this more seriously.' Last month, Cornell University professor Steven Strogatz also noted that mathematicians with 'rizz'—slang for personal charisma—are now more valued because they can explain AI-generated research results and use them to pose new mathematical questions. IT Home noted that AI companies' rapid entry into mathematics has left many mathematics researchers uneasy and confused. As OpenAI has pushed hundreds of solutions to the world's most complex mathematical problems into the field, the mathematics community is thinking about how to maintain its value in the AI era. Some professors have explicitly said they will no longer use AI. However, most are still trying to find ways to integrate the technology into their research. Students across the United States are also trying to adapt to the change and are asking professors to clearly publish AI usage guidelines explaining whether students may use such tools and how they should be used. One student wrote in a recent MIT survey: 'There is currently a lack of high-level leadership and guidance across academia.'
items.why_zh: 若卡莱加里的判断成立，AI 生成证明可能改变数学人才评估标准，使面试和表达能力更重要；这仍是一位学者的观点（推测）。
items.why_en: If Calegari's view proves correct, AI-generated proofs could change how math talent is evaluated, making interviews and communication skills more important; this remains one scholar's opinion (speculative).

items.title_zh: 三名男子涉嫌利用 AI 冒充企业高管和律师行骗，涉案金额超 1 亿美元
items.title_en: Three Men Charged in US With Using AI to Impersonate Executives and Lawyers in Fraud Exceeding $100 Million
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，当地时间 6 日，据英国《卫报》报道，美国司法部近日公布的一份起诉书显示，三名外国男子涉嫌 利用 AI 冒充企业 CEO 和律师 ，诈骗金额超过 1 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.69 亿元人民币） ，目前均被逮捕并受到起诉。 美国纽约南区联邦检察官办公室发布的新闻稿称，三名嫌疑人分别为雅各布 · 索尔、沙龙 · 哈赞和盖伊 · 谢特里特。他们涉嫌利用 AI 伪造多家企业高管和律师的声音、影像 ，诱骗企业员工汇出大额资金。 索尔和哈赞今年夏天在西班牙被捕，谢特里特于 9 月在英国落网。检方指控，三人的诈骗活动从 2024 年持续至 2026 年。 根据起诉书，三人先利用 AI 冒充企业高管，联系不同公司的员工，谎称有 敏感财务交易需要员工协助处理 ，再让员工与大型国际律师事务所的律师联系。随后，他们又冒充律师事务所的律师，指示员工汇出大笔资金。 美国司法部称，三人涉嫌从全球多家企业骗取超过 1.29 亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.63 亿元人民币） 。 一家总部设在密苏里州的医院集团损失近 500 万美元 （现汇率约合 3,345.4 万元人民币） 罗得岛州一家银行损失约 270 万美元 （现汇率约合 1,806.5 万元人民币） 加州一家医院集团损失约 300 万美元 （现汇率约合 2,007.2 万元人民币） 马萨诸塞州一家共同基金公司损失超过 460 万美元 （现汇率约合 3,077.8 万元人民币） 佛罗里达州一家宠物食品公司损失约 500 万美元 （现汇率约合 3,345.4 万元人民币） 一家英国科技公司遭骗取超过 1,100 万美元 （现汇率约合 7,359.9 万元人民币） 三人会要求受害企业员工将钱汇往分布在美国及欧亚多国的银行账户。美国司法部称，收到钱款后，他们会将赃款 兑换成加密货币 ，试图掩盖资金来源、所有权和实际控制情况，再与其他共谋者瓜分。 美国联邦检察官杰米 · 麦克唐纳发表声明指出，AI 具有巨大的发展潜力，但公众也应警惕有人利用这项技术从事犯罪活动。 美国联邦调查局（FBI）助理局长小詹姆斯 ·C· 巴纳克尔在声明中说：“索尔、哈赞和谢特里特涉嫌策划的诈骗案表明，先进技术可以被滥用于大规模欺诈。面对犯罪分子不断利用新兴技术作案，FBI 将继续迅速提升应对能力，识别、调查并打击企图侵害纽约居民及当地企业的犯罪分子。” 三人被控共谋 实施电信欺诈、洗钱共谋以及加重身份盗用 等罪名。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 8: On the 6th local time, The Guardian reported that a recently released US Department of Justice indictment shows three foreign men allegedly used AI to impersonate corporate CEOs and lawyers in a fraud totaling more than $100 million (about RMB 669 million at current exchange rates); all three have been arrested and charged. According to a press release from the US Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York, the three suspects are Jacob Sohl, Shalom Hazan and Guy Shetrit. They allegedly used AI to fabricate the voices and images of executives and lawyers at multiple companies to trick employees into wiring large sums. Sohl and Hazan were arrested in Spain this summer, and Shetrit was detained in the UK in September. Prosecutors allege the fraud ran from 2024 through 2026. According to the indictment, the three first used AI to impersonate executives, contacting employees at various companies and falsely claiming that sensitive financial transactions required their assistance, then directing employees to contact lawyers at large international law firms; they then impersonated those law firm lawyers and instructed employees to wire large sums. The Justice Department says the three allegedly defrauded companies worldwide of more than $129 million (about RMB 863 million at current rates): a Missouri-based hospital group lost nearly $5 million (about RMB 33.454 million), a Rhode Island bank lost about $2.7 million (about RMB 18.065 million), a California hospital group lost about $3 million (about RMB 20.072 million), a Massachusetts mutual fund company lost more than $4.6 million (about RMB 30.778 million), a Florida pet food company lost about $5 million (about RMB 33.454 million), and a UK tech company was defrauded of more than $11 million (about RMB 73.599 million). The three allegedly told victim employees to wire funds to bank accounts in the US and multiple countries in Europe and Asia, then converted the proceeds into cryptocurrency to conceal the source, ownership and actual control of the funds before splitting them with other co-conspirators. US Attorney Jamie McDonald said in a statement that AI has enormous potential but the public should also be alert to criminals using the technology. FBI Assistant Director James C. Barnacle Jr. said in a statement that the alleged scheme by Sohl, Hazan and Shetrit shows advanced technology can be abused for large-scale fraud, and that the FBI will keep rapidly upgrading its capabilities to identify, investigate and disrupt criminals seeking to harm New York residents and businesses. The three are charged with conspiracy to commit wire fraud, money laundering conspiracy and aggravated identity theft.
items.why_zh: （推测）若指控属实，这是生成式 AI 语音与影像伪造被用于大规模企业资金诈骗的突出案例，可能推动企业强化汇款环节的身份核验流程。
items.why_en: (Speculative) If the allegations hold, this is a prominent case of generative-AI voice and video impersonation being used for large-scale corporate wire fraud, and it may push companies to harden identity verification in payment workflows.

items.title_zh: Claude Max 订阅套餐使用额度被指“虚标”，Anthropic 辩词未获法官采纳
items.title_en: Claude Max usage limits alleged to be misleading; judge rejects Anthropic's defense
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，美国联邦治安法官谢文辉（Alex Tse）裁定，Anthropic 必须继续应对 Claude Max 套餐使用额度涉嫌误导消费者的主要指控。据 Courthouse News 报道，谢文辉周五驳回了案件中的其他几项诉求。 Anthropic 宣传称，月费 100 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 668.6 元人民币） 和 200 美元 （现汇率约合 1,337 元人民币） 的 Max 套餐，使用额度 分别是 Pro 套餐的 5 倍和 20 倍 。但今年 6 月提起诉讼的消费者指控，如果按整周计算，实际额度 远远达不到宣传中的倍数 。 两名原告卡尔 · 卡恩和所罗门 · 史密斯计算发现，以 Claude 的一款模型为例，200 美元 （现汇率约合 1,337 元人民币） 套餐的每周额度 只有 Pro 套餐的 6 倍 ，100 美元 （现汇率约合 668.6 元人民币） 套餐 则为 3.5 倍 。 问题出在额度计算方式上。Max 用户每 5 小时的使用额度确实可以达到 Pro 用户的 5 倍或 20 倍，但每周的使用上限并没有同比例增加。 Anthropic 辩称，消费者应该明白，宣传中的倍数 指的是单次使用周期的额度 ，并援引帮助页面作为依据。谢文辉并未采纳这一说法。裁决书写道：“Anthropic 对单次使用周期的说明，需要从 claude.com 的主要销售页面点击两次链接才能看到。” 谢文辉认为，既然消费者按月支付订阅费，就有理由认为 Anthropic 承诺的使用额度也是按月计算 。因此，原告可以继续追究 Anthropic 涉嫌过失性虚假陈述和违约的责任。 相关阅读： 《 美国消费者指控 Claude Max 订阅套餐额度“虚标”，拟对 Anthropic 发起集体诉讼 》
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, U.S. Magistrate Judge Alex Tse ruled that Anthropic must continue to face the main claims that Claude Max plan usage limits are misleading to consumers; Courthouse News reported that Tse dismissed several other claims in the case on Friday. Anthropic advertised that its $100 and $200 per month Max plans offer 5x and 20x the usage of the Pro plan. But consumers who sued in June allege that, measured on a weekly basis, actual limits fall far short of the advertised multiples. Two plaintiffs, Carl Kahn and Solomon Smith, calculated that for one Claude model, the $200 plan's weekly limit was only 6x Pro, and the $100 plan was 3.5x. The issue is how limits are calculated: Max users can indeed get 5x or 20x Pro usage per 5-hour period, but weekly caps do not increase proportionally. Anthropic argued that consumers should understand the advertised multiples refer to a single usage period's limit and cited its help page. Tse did not accept this, writing that “Anthropic's explanation of the single usage period requires two clicks from the main sales page on claude.com to see.” Tse reasoned that since consumers pay subscription fees monthly, they have reason to believe Anthropic's promised usage limits are also calculated monthly. The plaintiffs can therefore continue to pursue claims of negligent misrepresentation and breach of contract.

items.title_en: Largest power-equipment order by an AI company to date: Anthropic reportedly buys $3.4B in gas generators
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据英国《金融时报》今天（8 日）晚间报道，Anthropic 签下了一份大额数据中心燃气发电机组采购订单。 随着发电设备供应日趋紧张，AI 公司开始绕过中间商直接采购，进一步涉足能源行业。 报道披露，9 月下旬，Anthropic 斥资 34 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 227.49 亿元人民币） ，从美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的设备供应商 OnePWR Solutions 手中接下总功率达 1.7GW 的重型发电机组订单。 按照已知交易记录，这是 AI 公司 迄今规模最大的一笔发电设备采购订单 ，也反映出科技企业为争夺电力供应，正不断向能源行业延伸。 以往，AI 公司通常依靠公用事业公司和专业电力企业供电。但燃气轮机、发电机组需求激增，设备交货期延长至数年之后，资金雄厚的 AI 公司开始跳过中间环节，直接掌握发电能力。 据知情人士透露，OnePWR 两年前就向卡特彼勒订购了发电机组，仍需融资才能完成采购。Anthropic 原本打算向 OnePWR 购买服务，后来改变主意， 直接接手了 OnePWR 向卡特彼勒下达的设备订单 。 直接采购发电设备也帮助 SpaceX 迅速投入运营大型数据中心。今年早些时候，SpaceX 旗下 xAI 斥资 20 亿美元 （现汇率约合 133.82 亿元人民币） 购入移动式燃气轮机。谷歌母公司 Alphabet 则在 2025 年底收购了能源开发商 Intersect。 Anthropic 选择了另一种方式：不收购整家公司，也不只是单纯买设备， 而是接手多年前、设备涨价前签订的订单 。部分发电机组近期就能交付，其余设备也将在未来两年内到位。 Anthropic 同时是 SpaceX 的大客户。预计到今年年底，Anthropic 每月向 SpaceX 支付的算力租赁费用将达到 31 亿美元 （现汇率约合 207.42 亿元人民币） 。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 8: According to a Financial Times report this evening (Nov 8), Anthropic has signed a large order for gas generator sets for data centers. As power-generation equipment supply tightens, AI companies are bypassing intermediaries to buy directly and moving further into the energy sector. The report says that in late September Anthropic spent $3.4 billion (about RMB 22.749 billion at current exchange rates) to take over a 1.7GW order for heavy-duty generator sets from equipment supplier OnePWR Solutions of San Antonio, Texas. Based on known transaction records, this is the largest power-generation equipment purchase order by an AI company to date, reflecting how tech companies are extending into the energy industry to compete for electricity supply. AI companies previously relied on utilities and specialized power companies. But demand for gas turbines and generator sets has surged, with lead times extending to years, so cash-rich AI companies are skipping intermediaries to directly control generation capacity. According to people familiar with the matter, OnePWR ordered generator sets from Caterpillar two years ago and still needed financing to complete the purchase. Anthropic originally intended to buy services from OnePWR but changed its mind and directly took over OnePWR's equipment order with Caterpillar. Direct procurement of generation equipment also helped SpaceX quickly put large data centers into operation. Earlier this year, SpaceX's xAI spent $2 billion (about RMB 13.382 billion at current rates) to buy mobile gas turbines. Google parent Alphabet acquired energy developer Intersect at the end of 2025. Anthropic chose another approach: not acquiring an entire company and not merely buying equipment, but taking over an order signed years ago before equipment prices rose. Some generator sets can be delivered soon, and the rest will arrive within the next two years. Anthropic is also a major SpaceX customer. By the end of this year, Anthropic's monthly computing rental payments to SpaceX are expected to reach $3.1 billion (about RMB 20.742 billion at current rates).
items.why_zh: 若报道属实，这笔订单显示 AI 算力扩张正直接牵动发电设备与能源供应链，并可能加剧发电设备供应紧张（推测）。
items.why_en: If the report is accurate, the order shows that AI compute expansion is directly affecting power-generation equipment and energy supply chains, and may tighten generator supply further (speculation).

items.title_zh: 前 Rockstar 技术总监：爱好者“AI 移植游戏潮”或迫使官方加速发布《GTA6》PC 版
items.title_en: Former Rockstar Technical Director: Fan 'AI Game Porting Wave' May Force Official Accelerated Release of GTA 6 PC Version
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，前 Rockstar 技术总监 Obbe Vermeij 近日接受外媒《Rock Paper Shotgun》采访时表示，随着 AI 模型逐渐具备反编译和移植游戏的能力，Rockstar 可能已调整《GTA6》的 PC 版发行策略，避免黑客提前将主机平台的《GTA6》打包为可在 PC 平台运行的移植版本，进而影响游戏销量。 Vermeij 表示，近几个月 AI 技术的发展可能改变 Rockstar 长期以来的“先主机再 PC”游戏发行策略。尽管 AI 目前仍难以独立创作出能够媲美人类作品的原创游戏、电影和艺术内容，但在游戏反编译领域已经展现出较强能力，如今已有大量用户将各种游戏移植到各种平台，尽管此类移植作品的质量可能不及 Rockstar 官方团队的成果，但仍有可能分流玩家，损害游戏销量。 Vermeij 指出，《GTA 6》已经历多次大规模泄露事件，以 Take-Two 这样的大型游戏公司而言，完全有能力通过法律团队处理相关问题， 但由于《GTA》系列本身是现象级产品，一旦主机平台游戏包流出，法务部的速度可能跟不上爱好者利用 AI 移植游戏的速度 ，因此这种可能性会迫使 Rockstar 重新考虑 PC 版《GTA6》的发行计划。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 8: Former Rockstar technical director Obbe Vermeij said in a recent interview with Rock Paper Shotgun that as AI models gradually gain the ability to decompile and port games, Rockstar may have adjusted its PC release strategy for GTA 6 to prevent hackers from packaging the console version of GTA 6 into a PC-runnable port ahead of time and hurting game sales. Vermeij said AI advances in recent months may change Rockstar's long-standing 'console first, PC later' release strategy. Although AI still struggles to independently create original games, films and art comparable to human works, it has shown strong capabilities in game decompilation; many users now port various games to various platforms, and although such ports may be lower quality than Rockstar's official work, they could still divert players and damage sales. Vermeij noted that GTA 6 has suffered multiple large-scale leaks. A large game company like Take-Two can handle related issues through its legal team, but because the GTA series is a phenomenon-level product, once a console game package leaks, the legal department's speed may not keep up with fans using AI to port games, so this possibility may force Rockstar to reconsider its PC release plan for GTA 6.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这可能表明生成式 AI 的游戏移植能力正在影响 3A 游戏的平台发行节奏（推测）。
items.why_en: If accurate, this may indicate that generative AI's game-porting capabilities are influencing platform release timing for AAA games (speculative).

items.title_en: Bernstein: OpenAI Compute Infrastructure Spending May Reach $614 Billion by 2030, Below Earlier $750 Billion Rumor
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据智通财经报道，伯恩斯坦分析师 MarkMoerdler 估算，OpenAI 已披露的算力合作协议对应的基础设施支出， 到 2030 年累计可能达到 6,140 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 4.11 万亿元人民币） ， 明显低于《华尔街日报》此前传出的 7,500 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5.02 万亿元人民币） 。 据报道，该测算假设所有已识别合同均按计划执行，但实际支出可能因数据中心建设延期、项目取消及硬件采购安排调整而减少或推迟。由于相关算力通常分批交付，费用也将随设施投运逐步产生，而非立即形成付款义务，预计年度支出将在 2031 年达到 1,840 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1.23 万亿元人民币） 的峰值。 伯恩斯坦指出，OpenAI 与甲骨文、微软和亚马逊的相关协议规模分别约为 3,000 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2.01 万亿元人民币） 、2,500 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1.67 万亿元人民币） 和 1,380 亿美元 （现汇率约合 9,233.34 亿元人民币） ，期限通常为五至八年；与 CoreWeave 的协议上限为 224 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,498.75 亿元人民币） ，但不代表保底收入。 此外该行认为，大型云服务商短期面临的合同风险有限，真正值得警惕的是未来算力供应紧张局面缓解后，依赖高成本融资和持续租赁需求的专业算力供应商可能面临更大压力。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 8: According to Zhitong Finance, Bernstein analyst Mark Moerdler estimates that infrastructure spending corresponding to OpenAI's disclosed compute cooperation agreements may cumulatively reach $614 billion by 2030, significantly below the $750 billion previously reported by The Wall Street Journal. The estimate assumes all identified contracts are executed as planned, but actual spending may be reduced or delayed due to data center construction delays, project cancellations and adjustments to hardware procurement arrangements. Because related compute is usually delivered in batches, costs will be incurred gradually as facilities come online rather than immediately creating payment obligations; annual spending is expected to peak at $184 billion in 2031. Bernstein noted that OpenAI's agreements with Oracle, Microsoft and Amazon are about $300 billion, $250 billion and $138 billion respectively, typically with terms of five to eight years; its agreement with CoreWeave has a cap of $22.4 billion but does not represent guaranteed revenue. Bernstein also believes large cloud providers face limited short-term contract risk; the real concern is that specialized compute providers relying on high-cost financing and continuous leasing demand may face greater pressure after future compute supply tightness eases.
items.why_zh: 该测算若成立，可为评估 OpenAI 长期算力承诺与云厂商合同风险提供参考（推测）。
items.why_en: If the estimate holds, it could help assess OpenAI's long-term compute commitments and cloud providers' contract risks (speculative).

items.title_en: Report: Anthropic Still Pushing Ahead With IPO, Seeking Up to $100B; 'Largest IPO Ever' in Doubt
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据《金融时报》昨天报道，尽管美国科技股近期遭遇剧烈波动，Anthropic 仍在推进上市计划。这家来自美国的人工智能初创企业，已经做好接受低于乐观预期估值的准备。 据多位 Anthropic 投资者透露，这家美国公司仍计划在感恩节前进行 IPO（首次公开募股），预计募资 800 亿美元-1,000 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,352.66 亿元- 6,690.83 亿元人民币） ，目标估值为 1.25 万亿美元-1.75 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.36 万亿元- 11.71 万亿元人民币） 。 上述传闻中数字高于 Anthropic 目前的 9,650 亿美元 （现汇率约合 6.46 万亿元人民币） 估值， 但与投资者一个月前预计的翻倍水平相比存在不小差距 。 一位持有大量 Anthropic 股份的投资者表示：“我认为他们会采取非常保守的定价策略，比如将估值定在 1.5 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 10.04 万亿元人民币） ，然后再逐步上涨。”其他参与此次交易的人士则认为估值可能更低， 约为 1.3 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.7 万亿元人民币） 。 这种预期下调反映出科技行业正在重新评估市场走势。投资者们越来越担心借贷成本上升，以及 AI 企业不断膨胀的支出计划。大量 AI 概念股已经开始出现抛售现象，贷款机构也开始回避高风险项目。 本周美国中期选举，民主党取得压倒性胜利，部分原因在于该党候选人承诺阻止数据中心建设。这种结果进一步加速了市场抛售。 六名以上投资者透露，Anthropic 仍打算上市， CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫迪为此不得不接受估值下调 。 本周四美国股市剧烈震荡，单日蒸发 3.2 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 21.41 万亿元人民币） 市值。以科技股为主的纳斯达克 100 指数暴跌 6.4%，市场担忧 AI 基础设施投资热潮可能放缓。 市场研究机构 Vital Knowledge 分析师表示：“AI 股票遭到抛售，这让 Anthropic 上市变得更加困难，意味着可用于资本支出的资金减少，进而引发更多抛售。” 同时 OpenAI 也难以完成自己的私募融资。该公司已将寻求的估值从 1.4 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 9.37 万亿元人民币） 下调至 1.25 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.36 万亿元人民币） ，同时将融资规模从 300 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,007.25 亿元人民币） 缩减至 200 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,338.17 亿元人民币） 。 Anthropic 的支持者希望，本次 IPO 能够吸引一些被动卖家，即指数基金和大型资产管理公司。这些机构目前尚未持有 Anthropic 的股票，但在公司上市后不久，他们实际上将不得不买入相关股票。 此外 Anthropic 冲击“史上最大 IPO”的传闻也有变数。 据多位了解阿莫迪想法的人士透露 ， 他对超越马斯克 SpaceX 并没有太大兴趣 。 一位投资者表示：“他们并不在乎估值能否超过 SpaceX，也不追求 IPO 融资规模最大化。”Anthropic 的七位联合创始人已经承诺，将个人持有的公司股权中的 80% 捐赠给慈善事业。
items.summary_en: According to the Financial Times, despite recent sharp volatility in US tech stocks, Anthropic is still pushing ahead with its IPO plan and is prepared to accept a valuation below optimistic expectations. Several investors said the company still plans to hold its IPO before Thanksgiving, expecting to raise US$80 billion to US$100 billion, with a target valuation of US$1.25 trillion to US$1.75 trillion. These reported figures are higher than Anthropic's current US$965 billion valuation but well below the doubled level investors had expected a month ago. One investor holding a large stake said the company may adopt very conservative pricing, for example setting the valuation at US$1.5 trillion first and then letting it rise gradually; other people involved in the deal believe the valuation could be lower, around US$1.3 trillion. The lowered expectations reflect the tech industry's reassessment of the market: investors are increasingly worried about rising borrowing costs and AI companies' expanding spending plans, AI-related stocks have seen sell-offs, and lenders are starting to avoid high-risk projects. In this week's US midterm elections, Democrats won a landslide victory, partly because their candidates promised to block data center construction; this further accelerated the market sell-off. More than six investors said Anthropic still intends to go public, and CEO Dario Amodei has had to accept a valuation cut. On Thursday, US stocks swung sharply, losing US$3.2 trillion in market value in a single day; the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 plunged 6.4% as the market worried that the AI infrastructure investment boom could slow. Analysts at Vital Knowledge said the sell-off in AI stocks makes Anthropic's IPO more difficult, meaning less money available for capital expenditure, which in turn triggers more selling. At the same time, OpenAI is also struggling to complete its private financing. It has lowered the valuation it is seeking from US$1.4 trillion to US$1.25 trillion and reduced the financing size from US$30 billion to US$20 billion. Anthropic's supporters hope the IPO can attract passive buyers such as index funds and large asset managers. In addition, the reported bid for the 'largest IPO ever' also faces uncertainty. People familiar with Amodei's thinking said he is not very interested in surpassing Elon Musk's SpaceX. One investor said: 'They don't care whether the valuation exceeds SpaceX's, nor do they seek to maximize the IPO fundraising size.' Anthropic's seven co-founders have pledged to donate 80% of their personally held company equity to charity.
items.why_zh: 若报道属实，这将是 AI 热潮下备受关注的上市交易，但在市场抛售和估值下调背景下仍存变数；信息来自匿名投资者，尚未获官方确认（推测）。
items.why_en: If the report is accurate, this would be a closely watched IPO amid the AI boom, but it remains uncertain amid sell-offs and valuation cuts; the information comes from unnamed investors and has not been officially confirmed (speculative).

items.title_zh: 埃森哲报告被曝存在虚假引用案例，公司否认系 AI 幻觉所致
items.title_en: Accenture Report Allegedly Contains Fake Citations; Company Denies AI Hallucinations Caused Them
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，埃森哲（Accenture）被指发布了一份充斥人工智能“幻觉”的研究报告，其中不仅包含大量虚假信息，还出现了多处疑似捏造的研究案例。 据 GPTZero 最新分析，这家咨询巨头发布的一份报告涉嫌包含 15 条虚假引用，以及完全虚构的案例研究，因此正受到外界审查。 这份名为《跨越式发展》（Leapfrogging Development）的报告由埃森哲与马德里 IE 大学的研究人员合作发布，旨在探讨人工智能如何提高非洲农业产业的生产力。 埃森哲否认相关错误是由人工智能造成的。 不过，这一事件仍可能令埃森哲陷入尴尬境地。此前，该公司管理层曾威胁称，不愿使用人工智能的员工可能面临解雇。 埃森哲首席执行官朱莉 · 斯威特（Julie Sweet）去年曾警告称，作为公司人工智能转型工作的一部分，未能使用这项技术的顾问将被公司“淘汰”。 GPTZero 的报告凸显了咨询行业日益广泛使用人工智能所引发的担忧。其中一个风险在于，人工智能“幻觉”可能通过聊天机器人回答和摘要传播虚假信息，进而“污染信息源”。 GPTZero 表示：“该公司认为，虚构引用对研究人员、学者、顾问、学生，以及任何通过互联网搜索信息的人而言，都是迫在眉睫的现实威胁。” 这并非咨询行业首次出现类似事件。此前，德勤、安永、毕马威和普华永道等大型咨询公司也曾被指在报告中出现人工智能错误。 与此同时，全球一些规模最大、收费最高的律师事务所，也已承认在重要法律文件中出现过人工智能生成的错误。 英国大型律师事务所之一 Pinsent Masons 此前承认，其提交给英国高等法院的法律文件中包含人工智能“幻觉”内容。 另一家律师事务所 Sullivan & Cromwell 的律师收费最高可达每小时 3,000 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20,058 元人民币） ，该公司也于今年早些时候承认，提交给纽约一家法院的文件中存在人工智能错误。 埃森哲是众多积极推动员工使用人工智能的专业服务公司之一。 不过，由于员工使用需求过于旺盛，该公司上个月被迫对人工智能工具的使用设置新的限制。此前，部分员工使用 Claude 等工具产生的月度账单超过 1,000 美元 （现汇率约合 6,686 元人民币） 。 埃森哲一名发言人对 GPTZero 的研究结果提出异议，称：“我们的审查表明，报告中发现的错误源于人为失误。没有证据支持这些错误是由人工智能幻觉造成的这一结论。我们正在修正这份报告，并将在重新发布前完成相关工作。我们始终欢迎借此机会进一步提升报告质量。”
items.summary_en: IT Home, November 8: Accenture has been accused of publishing a research report filled with AI 'hallucinations,' containing not only substantial false information but also multiple suspected fabricated case studies. According to a new analysis by GPTZero, a report published by the consulting giant allegedly contains 15 fake citations and entirely fictional case studies, and is therefore under scrutiny. The report, titled 'Leapfrogging Development,' was published by Accenture in collaboration with researchers at IE University in Madrid and aims to explore how AI can improve productivity in Africa's agricultural industry. Accenture denies that the errors were caused by AI. However, the incident may still put Accenture in an awkward position. Previously, the company's management threatened that employees unwilling to use AI could face dismissal. Accenture CEO Julie Sweet warned last year that, as part of the company's AI transformation, consultants who fail to use the technology would be 'eliminated' by the company. GPTZero's report highlights concerns raised by the consulting industry's growing use of AI. One risk is that AI 'hallucinations' may spread false information through chatbot answers and summaries, thereby 'polluting information sources.' GPTZero said: 'The company believes that fabricated citations are an imminent real-world threat to researchers, scholars, consultants, students, and anyone who searches for information via the internet.' This is not the first such incident in the consulting industry. Previously, major consulting firms including Deloitte, EY, KPMG, and PwC have also been accused of AI errors in their reports. At the same time, some of the world's largest and most expensive law firms have acknowledged AI-generated errors in important legal documents. Pinsent Masons, one of the UK's major law firms, previously admitted that legal documents it submitted to the UK High Court contained AI 'hallucinations.' Sullivan & Cromwell, another law firm whose lawyers can charge up to US$3,000 per hour, also admitted earlier this year that documents submitted to a New York court contained AI errors. Accenture is one of many professional services firms actively pushing employees to use AI. However, because employee demand was too strong, the company was forced last month to set new limits on AI tool usage. Previously, some employees' monthly bills for using tools such as Claude exceeded US$1,000. An Accenture spokesperson disputed GPTZero's findings, saying: 'Our review indicates that the errors found in the report stem from human error. There is no evidence to support the conclusion that these errors were caused by AI hallucinations. We are correcting the report and will complete the work before republishing it. We always welcome the opportunity to further improve the quality of our reports.'
items.why_zh: 若 GPTZero 的分析属实，这将凸显专业服务与研究中 AI 生成内容核验的风险；但埃森哲否认 AI 是错误成因（推测）。
items.why_en: If GPTZero's analysis is accurate, it would highlight the risks of verifying AI-generated content in professional services and research; however, Accenture denies that AI caused the errors (speculative).

items.title_en: Physical-Intelligence Open-Source Platform Hitch Open Launched at CIIE; AI Robot Table-Tennis Rally of 142 Shots Sets World Record
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据临港集团，11 月 7 日，第九届中国国际进口博览会迎来物理智能领域全球首秀。 来自美国加州硅谷、学术底座源自加州大学伯克利分校的全球物理智能开源平台 Hitch Open，在进博会临港展示区举行全球发布会， 正式面向全球开源发布物理智能平台 。 IT之家获悉，现场完成 AI 自主决策机器人乒乓对打挑战，由上海交通大学 — 上海创智学院高岳教授团队与 Hitch Open 平台联合创造 142 拍 新成绩， 刷新该项目世界纪录 。 据介绍，Hitch Open 是面向真实物理环境的物理智能竞技平台，致力于通过真实环境下的极限赛事，解决人工智能在复杂物理世界中完成感知、决策与行动的核心挑战，推动自动驾驶、具身智能及机器人技术的发展。 而乒乓对打，是物理智能的“极限考场”。乒乓球球速快、旋转变化复杂， 留给机器人的反应窗口仅有百毫秒 ，要求机器人在“感知 — 决策 — 行动”闭环内完成实时研判。每多一个回合，都代表着机器人感知精度、决策速度与运动控制能力的同步跃升。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 8: According to Lingang Group, on Nov 7 the ninth China International Import Expo hosted a global debut in the physical-intelligence field. Hitch Open, a global open-source physical-intelligence platform from Silicon Valley in California with academic roots at UC Berkeley, held a global launch event in the CIIE Lingang exhibition area, formally open-sourcing the platform worldwide. IT之家 learned that an AI autonomous-decision robot table-tennis rally challenge was completed on site, with a team led by Professor Gao Yue of Shanghai Jiao Tong University–Shanghai Innovation Institute for Intelligence and Hitch Open jointly setting a new mark of 142 shots, a world record for the event. According to the introduction, Hitch Open is a physical-intelligence competition platform for real physical environments, aiming through extreme events in real settings to solve the core challenge of enabling AI to perceive, decide and act in a complex physical world, and to advance autonomous driving, embodied intelligence and robotics. Table-tennis rallying is described as an "extreme exam" for physical intelligence: with fast ball speeds and complex spin variation, the reaction window left to the robot is only about a hundred milliseconds, requiring real-time judgment within a perceive–decide–act loop; each additional exchange represents a simultaneous jump in the robot's perception accuracy, decision speed and motion control.
items.why_zh: （推测）以公开赛事与开源平台的方式设定可复现的物理智能评测，或有助于比较具身智能与机器人控制方案在真实环境中的进展。
items.why_en: (Speculative) Setting reproducible physical-intelligence benchmarks through public competitions and an open-source platform may help compare progress in embodied-intelligence and robot-control approaches in real environments.

items.title_zh: 消息称广汽人形机器人预计 2029 年形成万台产能
items.title_en: Report: GAC Humanoid Robots Expected to Reach 10,000-Unit Annual Capacity by 2029
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，11 月 5 日，广东慧仑科技有限公司与广汽集团动力业务单元（“广汽动力 BU”）正式签署具身智能机器人生产合作协议。 据第一财经报道，慧仑科技与广汽动力 BU 双方正按协议推进产线建设， 预计将于 2029 年形成万台级产能 。目前广汽人形机器人仍处于小批量应用阶段，累计运行数据超过 12 个月、6.3 万公里、18.9 万次。 据IT之家此前报道，2 月 26 日， 广汽集团宣布孵化成立广东慧仑科技有限公司 。慧仑科技以独立主体身份开展市场化运营， 全面承接广汽集团在具身智能领域的业务 。 今年 8 月， 慧仑科技宣布完成超亿元融资 。本次融资资金将主要用于垂类模型优化、汽车产线及综合服务场景拓展、核心产品迭代和人才团队建设，进一步推动人形机器人整机与核心零部件的规模化应用。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 8: On Nov 5, Guangdong Huilun Technology Co., Ltd. and GAC Group's Power Business Unit ('GAC Power BU') formally signed a production cooperation agreement for embodied intelligent robots. According to Yicai, Huilun Technology and GAC Power BU are advancing production line construction under the agreement and are expected to form 10,000-unit-level annual capacity by 2029. GAC's humanoid robots are still in small-batch application, with cumulative operating data exceeding 12 months, 63,000 kilometers and 189,000 operations. IT Home previously reported that on Feb 26 GAC Group announced the incubation and establishment of Guangdong Huilun Technology. Huilun Technology operates on a market basis as an independent entity and fully takes on GAC Group's embodied intelligence business. In August this year, Huilun Technology announced completion of over 100 million yuan in financing. The funds will mainly be used for vertical model optimization, expansion of automotive production line and comprehensive service scenarios, core product iteration and talent team building, further promoting large-scale application of complete humanoid robots and core components.

items.why_en: If the capacity target is met, it may reflect automakers' intent to move embodied intelligence from pilot applications toward scaled manufacturing (speculative).

items.title_zh: GitHub 推出新 Git 存储架构：内部测试单个代码仓库支持 5000 个智能体同时协作，每秒处理 7200 次推送
items.title_en: GitHub unveils new Git storage architecture: internal test supports 5,000 agents collaborating in one repo and 7,200 pushes per second
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，当地时间 11 月 5 日，GitHub 发布博文，称上周在 GitHub Universe 大会上，正式公布了全新的 Git 存储架构，代号“Rubicon”。 官方表示，该架构不仅具备每秒处理数千次写入的能力，还能实现读取按需水平扩展。经内部压力测试验证，新架构能够在保持极低读取延迟的同时， 支持单个代码仓库容纳 5000 个智能体（Agent）并发协作，并承受每秒高达 7200 次的代码推送 。 IT之家获悉，该架构目前已经开启 小范围定向内测（limited private preview） ，并计划于 明年初逐步扩大开放范围 。 据介绍，如今 GitHub 上最繁忙的代码仓库，其单秒写入峰值最多也不过数十次，且往往呈现短暂脉冲式的突发状态。然而，随着越来越多的研发工作交由全天候高并发运行的 AI 智能体处理，预计在未来一年内，这种瞬时突发将演变为常态化的持续高吞吐负载。 每一次代码推送（Push）都会级联触发更多的读取请求：CI 流水线即刻启动、部署系统拉取最新提交，其他协同智能体也会同步获取代码作为上下文。这种读操作的扇出扩散（Read Fan-out），随着写入频率的攀升，对平台整体流量产生了极为显著的放大效应。 在流量分布曲线最顶端的头部仓库中，这一趋势已然显现。下方图表展示了 GitHub 上某个典型代码仓库在 3 月至 5 月期间的日请求量变化 —— 短短两个月内，其流量便激增了约 4 倍；此后至今，其访问增长更始终维持着陡峭的指数级上升轨迹。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, GitHub said in a Nov 5 blog post that it officially unveiled a new Git storage architecture codenamed “Rubicon” at GitHub Universe last week. GitHub says the architecture can handle thousands of writes per second and scale reads horizontally on demand. Internal stress tests verified that it can support 5,000 agents collaborating concurrently in a single repository while maintaining very low read latency, and withstand up to 7,200 code pushes per second. The architecture is now in limited private preview, with broader access planned to expand gradually early next year. GitHub says the busiest repositories today peak at only dozens of writes per second, often in short bursts; but as more development work is handled by AI agents running around the clock at high concurrency, such bursts are expected to become sustained high-throughput loads within the next year. Every push triggers cascading reads: CI pipelines start immediately, deployment systems pull the latest commits, and other collaborating agents fetch code as context; this read fan-out amplifies overall platform traffic as write frequency rises. GitHub says this trend is already visible among top repositories: one typical repository's daily requests grew about fourfold from March to May, and access growth has since maintained a steep exponential trajectory.
items.why_zh: 推测：若 AI 智能体持续高并发写入成为常态，代码托管平台需重构存储与读扩展架构。
items.why_en: Speculation: if sustained high-concurrency writes by AI agents become normal, code hosting platforms will need to redesign storage and read-scaling architectures.

items.title_zh: 上海交大构建 AI 原生科学实验室 AutoDNA 装置：实现自主分子生物学实验操作，成果登《自然》
items.title_en: Shanghai Jiao Tong University builds AI-native science lab AutoDNA, enabling autonomous molecular biology experiments; results published in Nature
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，上海交通大学计算机学院 IPADS 实验室陈海波、王肇国团队与化学化工学院、变革性分子前沿科学中心樊春海、王飞团队合作，依托张江高等研究院 DNA 存储研究中心开展研究， 成果发表于《自然》（Nature）杂志 ，并获该刊官网首页头条重点报道。 研究团队构建了 AI 原生科学实验室 AutoDNA 装置（思源一号），实现了自主分子生物学实验操作 ，通过对模型、实验与仪器进行协同设计，解决了现有 AI 自主科学实验室向分子生物学实验拓展时，在复杂流程组织、多类仪器协同以及实验时序、环境稳定性和操作精度保障等方面面临的难题，使自主实验能够覆盖需要微米级定位和微升级液体处理的复杂生物分子实验场景。 据介绍，已有 AI 自主科学实验室通常由专家预先配置仪器、规定实验流程和设定优化规则，再将人工智能接入文献检索、方案生成或数据分析等局部环节。这种“外挂式”架构虽能提升单个环节的效率，却难以适应生物分子实验流程复杂、仪器类型多样，以及对实时执行、环境稳定和操作精度要求严格等特点。为此， AutoDNA 采用 AI 原生架构，通过模型-实验-仪器协同设计的思路解决上述问题 。 针对实验流程复杂的问题 ，AutoDNA 结合对适用于复杂生物分子操作的实验过程理解，构建了面向实验的多智能体架构。系统将复杂实验任务分解为文献检索、试剂选择、方案设计、代码生成、硬件执行、结果分析和迭代优化等环节，并根据实验进展组织多个专业智能体协同工作，使模型能够贯通“设计 — 实验 — 优化”全过程，并依据实验结果持续迭代调整后续方案。 针对仪器种类多、跨设备协作困难的问题 ，AutoDNA 将各类仪器的能力提炼为适合模型理解和调用的“原子服务”，以自然语言说明和统一代码接口告诉模型每台设备“能做什么、如何调用”。这层抽象屏蔽了不同型号仪器的底层差异，使模型能够根据实验需求组合设备能力，生成、检查和修正跨设备控制代码，将数字世界中的实验设计转化为物理世界中的仪器操作。 针对实验对实时性、稳定性和操作精度的严格要求 ，AutoDNA 将高精度自动化硬件和实验执行与调度系统相结合。硬件提供微米级定位和微升级液体处理能力，系统则负责程序检查、仪器状态跟踪和资源调度，使多个实验任务在满足时序和操作约束的前提下有序运行。 平台在构建过程中还集成了基于 OpenHarmony 操作系统的控制终端 ，并展示了在核酸检测、酶促 DNA 合成、癌症检测等场景中的应用验证。 ▲ AutoDNA 自主完成端到端 DNA 存储的编码、写入、保存、读取与解码流程 IT之家附论文链接： https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11228-6
items.summary_en: Chen Haibo and Wang Zhaoguo's team at the IPADS Lab of Shanghai Jiao Tong University's School of Computer Science collaborated with Fan Chunhai and Wang Fei's teams from the School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering and the Frontiers Science Center for Transformative Molecules, carrying out research based at the DNA Storage Research Center of Zhangjiang Institute for Advanced Study. They built an AI-native science laboratory device called AutoDNA (Siyuan-1), achieving autonomous molecular biology experiment operations. The results were published in Nature and featured as a homepage headline on the journal's website. AutoDNA uses model-experiment-instrument co-design to address complex workflow organization, coordination of multiple instruments, and requirements for experimental timing, environmental stability and operational precision. It uses a multi-agent architecture to decompose literature search, reagent selection, protocol design, code generation, hardware execution, result analysis and iterative optimization; abstracts instrument capabilities into "atomic services" callable by models; and combines high-precision automation hardware with execution and scheduling systems for micrometer-level positioning and microliter-level liquid handling. The platform also integrates a control terminal based on OpenHarmony and demonstrates validation in nucleic acid testing, enzymatic DNA synthesis and cancer detection, as well as an end-to-end DNA storage workflow of encoding, writing, storage, reading and decoding. Paper: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11228-6

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，上海交通大学计算机学院 IPADS 实验室陈海波、王肇国团队与化学化工学院、变革性分子前沿科学中心樊春海、王飞团队合作，依托张江高等研究院 DNA 存储研究中心开展研究， 成果发表于《自然》（Nature）杂志 ，并获该刊官网首页头条重点报道。 研究团队构建了 AI 原生科学实验室 AutoDNA 装置（思源一号），实现了自主分子生物学实验操作 ，通过对模型、实验与仪器进行协同设计，解决了现有 AI 自主科学实验室向分子生物学实验拓展时，在复杂流程组织、多类仪器协同以及实验时序、环境稳定性和操作精度保障等方面面临的难题，使自主实验能够覆盖需要微米级定位和微升级液体处理的复杂生物分子实验场景。 据介绍，已有 AI 自主科学实验室通常由专家预先配置仪器、规定实验流程和设定优化规则，再将人工智能接入文献检索、方案生成或数据分析等局部环节。这种“外挂式”架构虽能提升单个环节的效率，却难以适应生物分子实验流程复杂、仪器类型多样，以及对实时执行、环境稳定和操作精度要求严格等特点。为此， AutoDNA 采用 AI 原生架构，通过模型-实验-仪器协同设计的思路解决上述问题 。 针对实验流程复杂的问题 ，AutoDNA 结合对适用于复杂生物分子操作的实验过程理解，构建了面向实验的多智能体架构。系统将复杂实验任务分解为文献检索、试剂选择、方案设计、代码生成、硬件执行、结果分析和迭代优化等环节，并根据实验进展组织多个专业智能体协同工作，使模型能够贯通“设计 — 实验 — 优化”全过程，并依据实验结果持续迭代调整后续方案。 针对仪器种类多、跨设备协作困难的问题 ，AutoDNA 将各类仪器的能力提炼为适合模型理解和调用的“原子服务”，以自然语言说明和统一代码接口告诉模型每台设备“能做什么、如何调用”。这层抽象屏蔽了不同型号仪器的底层差异，使模型能够根据实验需求组合设备能力，生成、检查和修正跨设备控制代码，将数字世界中的实验设计转化为物理世界中的仪器操作。 针对实验对实时性、稳定性和操作精度的严格要求 ，AutoDNA 将高精度自动化硬件和实验执行与调度系统相结合。硬件提供微米级定位和微升级液体处理能力，系统则负责程序检查、仪器状态跟踪和资源调度，使多个实验任务在满足时序和操作约束的前提下有序运行。 平台在构建过程中还集成了基于 OpenHarmony 操作系统的控制终端 ，并展示了在核酸检测、酶促 DNA 合成、癌症检测等场景中的应用验证。 ▲ AutoDNA 自主完成端到端 DNA 存储的编码、写入、保存、读取与解码流程 IT之家附论文链接： https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11228-6

items.title_zh: 日本富士电视台将在所有真人剧集制作中使用 AI，可省七至八成特效制作工序
items.title_en: Japan's Fuji TV to use AI in all live-action drama production, cutting VFX work by 70–80%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据日经亚洲当地时间 6 日报道，富士电视台计划从 2027 年 10 月起，将生成式 AI 应用于 所有真人电视剧的制作 ，大幅缩短制作周期。由此，富士电视台将成为日本首家全面引入 AI 参与节目制作的大型商业电视台。 富士电视台 每年制作 16 部电视剧 ，计划使用谷歌 AI 图像生成和编辑工具 Nano Banana。AI 制作工作将交给富士电视台 9 月成立的内部实验室 AI Sandbox，主要由东京制作公司 ANDENT 培训的 CG 设计师负责，开展 AI 技术的测试和应用实验。 AI 技术也被用于富士电视台播出中的医疗剧《救命病栋 24 小时》。第一集中， 一段手术切口流血的镜头就是由 AI 生成的 。以往制作类似场景，需要借助 视觉特效 ，或者使用真实液体模拟血液喷溅。 新技术的制作流程是先在本地环境中利用 事先拍摄的素材训练 AI ，再通过提示词生成符合剧情需要的画面。色调等细节如果未达到创作团队的要求，则在后期进行调整。与传统视觉特效制作相比，AI 可省去 70% 至 80% 的工序 。 富士电视台还打算根据实际需要，在前期策划乃至开拍后灵活运用 AI， 作为实景拍摄和视觉特效的补充选择 。 富士电视台负责制作战略的主管透露，是否使用 AI，要根据成片质量来决定。“最重要的是让电视剧营造的世界 真实可信 。” AI 还能降低拍摄成本。《救命病栋 24 小时》系列新作的一段爆炸场面原本需要直升机进行航拍， 最终通过 AI 生成了俯拍画面 。 富士电视台技术艺术设计局的真崎晋哉解释道：“我们担心今后把 AI 制作交给外部公司会增加成本，因此选择自己制作。” 随着观众逐渐不再收看传统电视，地面电视广告收入不断下滑。2025 财年，日本五大商业电视台共投入 3,657 亿日元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 154.56 亿元人民币） 制作节目，较 9 年前减少 12%。 面对节目预算不断缩减，富士电视台希望借助 AI 维持制作质量。TBS 电视台、日本电视台等日本其他电视台，也在电视剧制作中推进类似计划。
items.summary_en: According to Nikkei Asia on the 6th local time, Fuji TV plans to apply generative AI to all live-action drama production starting in October 2027 to significantly shorten production cycles; it will become the first major commercial broadcaster in Japan to fully introduce AI into program production. Fuji TV produces 16 dramas per year and plans to use Google's AI image generation and editing tool Nano Banana. AI production will be handled by its internal lab AI Sandbox, established in September, mainly by CG designers trained by Tokyo production company ANDENT to conduct testing and application experiments. In the first episode of its medical drama "Kyuumei Byoin 24-ji," a shot of a surgical incision bleeding was generated by AI. The workflow first trains AI in a local environment using previously shot footage, then generates images via prompts, with details such as color tone adjusted in post-production. Compared with traditional visual effects, AI can save 70% to 80% of the work processes. Fuji TV also plans to flexibly use AI in early planning and even after shooting begins, as a supplementary option to live-action shooting and visual effects, and will decide whether to use it based on the quality of the final cut. AI also lowers shooting costs; for example, an explosion scene in a new work originally required helicopter aerial photography but was ultimately generated by AI as an overhead shot. Shinya Masaki of Fuji TV's Technical Art Design Bureau explained that they were concerned that outsourcing AI production to external companies in the future would increase costs, so they chose to produce it in-house. As audiences increasingly stop watching traditional TV and terrestrial TV advertising revenue declines, Japan's five major commercial broadcasters invested a total of 365.7 billion yen in program production in fiscal 2025, down 12% from nine years earlier. Fuji TV hopes to use AI to maintain production quality, and TBS, Nippon TV and others are also advancing similar plans.
items.why_zh: 推测：若全面落地，这可能改变电视剧制作流程与成本结构，并成为观察日本商业电视台采用生成式 AI 的案例。
items.why_en: Speculative: if fully implemented, this could change drama production workflows and cost structures, and serve as a case for observing Japanese commercial broadcasters' adoption of generative AI.

items.title_zh: 腾讯姚顺雨谈“AI 模型公司护城河”：更多存在于产品层，而不是模型层
items.title_en: Tencent's Yao Shunyu says AI model companies' moat lies more in products than in models
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据第一财经报道，在 2026 未来科学大奖的一场对话中，清华大学讲席教授、中国工程院外籍院士张亚勤向腾讯首席 AI 科学家姚顺雨抛出了一个尖锐的商业问题， 模型公司的护城河究竟是什么 ？ 姚顺雨的回答是， AI 护城河更多存在于产品层，而不是模型层 。真正难以替代的，不一定是最聪明的模型，而是能够理解用户背景、利用专有数据和上下文，并获得用户信任的 AI 产品。 姚顺雨以微信为例，如果用户可以直接在微信中使用 AI，这个 AI 未必需要拥有最强大的模型能力，但它了解用户的日程安排、朋友关系和各种活动信息。这些信息能够帮助 AI 更好地理解用户需要什么，也使其他模型难以直接替代它。即使竞争对手推出了一个更聪明的模型，也不意味着它能够提供同样的服务，因为后者未必知道用户是谁。 听完这一回答，张亚勤调侃道，按照姚顺雨的逻辑，Anthropic 未来或许不值一万亿甚至两万亿美元，因为模型终有一天可能走向商品化。随后，张亚勤又笑着提醒现场的学生，千万不要听自己的建议去买股票。 IT之家注：姚顺雨本科毕业于清华大学姚班，获普林斯顿大学计算机科学博士学位，2024 年加入 OpenAI 并参与智能体产品 operator 与 deep research 开发。其研究聚焦语言智能体与现实世界交互，提出 ReAct 方法首创“推理 — 行动”结合的智能体范式，被学术界与工业界广泛采纳。 2025 年 12 月，腾讯升级大模型研发架构，新成立 AI Infra 部、AI Data 部、数据计算平台部，全面强化其大模型的研发体系与核心能力。 姚顺雨出任“CEO / 总裁办公室”首席 AI 科学家 ，向腾讯总裁刘炽平汇报；同时兼任 AI Infra 部、大语言模型部负责人，向技术工程事业群总裁卢山汇报。 今年 7 月，腾讯宣布混元多模态模型部门与大语言模型部门合并，成立基础模型部， 统一由姚顺雨管理 ，以进一步提升模型研发和协同效率，探索全模态模型的智能上限。
items.summary_en: According to Yicai, in a dialogue at the 2026 Future Science Prize, Zhang Ya-qin, chair professor at Tsinghua University and foreign member of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, asked Tencent Chief AI Scientist Yao Shunyu a pointed business question: what exactly is the moat of model companies? Yao replied that AI moats lie more in the product layer than in the model layer. What is truly hard to replace is not necessarily the smartest model, but an AI product that understands users' backgrounds, uses proprietary data and context, and gains user trust. He cited WeChat as an example: if users could use AI directly within WeChat, that AI would not necessarily need the strongest model capabilities, but it would know users' schedules, friendships and various activity information, helping it better understand what users need and making it harder for other models to directly replace it. Even if a competitor launched a smarter model, that would not mean it could provide the same service, because the latter might not know who the user is. After hearing this, Zhang Ya-qin joked that under Yao's logic, Anthropic might not be worth $1 trillion or even $2 trillion in the future, because models may eventually become commoditized; he then smilingly reminded students not to buy stocks based on his advice. The article notes that Yao Shunyu graduated from Tsinghua University's Yao Class as an undergraduate, received a PhD in computer science from Princeton University, joined OpenAI in 2024 and participated in developing the agent products operator and deep research. His research focuses on language agents and interaction with the real world, and he proposed the ReAct method, pioneering the "reasoning-action" agent paradigm. In December 2025, Tencent upgraded its large-model R&D structure, establishing the AI Infra Department, AI Data Department and Data Computing Platform Department; Yao became Chief AI Scientist in the "CEO/President's Office," reporting to Tencent President Liu Chiping, and also heads the AI Infra Department and Large Language Model Department, reporting to Lu Shan, president of the Technology Engineering Group. In July this year, Tencent announced the merger of the Hunyuan multimodal model department and the large language model department into a Foundation Model Department, managed uniformly by Yao Shunyu.
items.why_zh: 推测：这一表态把竞争焦点从模型能力转向产品、数据和用户信任，可能影响外界评估 AI 公司护城河的方式；但其实际适用性仍需观察。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据第一财经报道，在 2026 未来科学大奖的一场对话中，清华大学讲席教授、中国工程院外籍院士张亚勤向腾讯首席 AI 科学家姚顺雨抛出了一个尖锐的商业问题， 模型公司的护城河究竟是什么 ？ 姚顺雨的回答是， AI 护城河更多存在于产品层，而不是模型层 。真正难以替代的，不一定是最聪明的模型，而是能够理解用户背景、利用专有数据和上下文，并获得用户信任的 AI 产品。 姚顺雨以微信为例，如果用户可以直接在微信中使用 AI，这个 AI 未必需要拥有最强大的模型能力，但它了解用户的日程安排、朋友关系和各种活动信息。这些信息能够帮助 AI 更好地理解用户需要什么，也使其他模型难以直接替代它。即使竞争对手推出了一个更聪明的模型，也不意味着它能够提供同样的服务，因为后者未必知道用户是谁。 听完这一回答，张亚勤调侃道，按照姚顺雨的逻辑，Anthropic 未来或许不值一万亿甚至两万亿美元，因为模型终有一天可能走向商品化。随后，张亚勤又笑着提醒现场的学生，千万不要听自己的建议去买股票。 IT之家注：姚顺雨本科毕业于清华大学姚班，获普林斯顿大学计算机科学博士学位，2024 年加入 OpenAI 并参与智能体产品 operator 与 deep research 开发。其研究聚焦语言智能体与现实世界交互，提出 ReAct 方法首创“推理 — 行动”结合的智能体范式，被学术界与工业界广泛采纳。 2025 年 12 月，腾讯升级大模型研发架构，新成立 AI Infra 部、AI Data 部、数据计算平台部，全面强化其大模型的研发体系与核心能力。 姚顺雨出任“CEO / 总裁办公室”首席 AI 科学家 ，向腾讯总裁刘炽平汇报；同时兼任 AI Infra 部、大语言模型部负责人，向技术工程事业群总裁卢山汇报。 今年 7 月，腾讯宣布混元多模态模型部门与大语言模型部门合并，成立基础模型部， 统一由姚顺雨管理 ，以进一步提升模型研发和协同效率，探索全模态模型的智能上限。

items.title_zh: 谷歌 AI 新研究：无需袖带利用消费级智能手表检测高血压，成果登 Nature
items.title_en: Google AI research: cuffless hypertension detection with consumer smartwatches, published in Nature
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，当地时间 11 月 5 日，谷歌发布博文，介绍在《自然》（Nature）发表的最新研究成果。 谷歌推出了名为 AI-PPG-ACC-HTN 的多模态 AI 系统。该系统无需袖带校准，使用普通消费级智能手表便能被动检测高血压迹象。 官方表示，与常规方案试图估算极易受瞬时环境噪声干扰的单次瞬时收缩压与舒张压不同，新系统转变了解决思路：通过聚合连续多天采集的被动生理特征， 专注于识别个体潜在且持续存在的高血压状态 。 自监督预训练 ：使用超 49 万小时无标注数据训练 1D-CNN，通过对比学习让模型自主挖掘复杂的心血管生理特征。 多天聚合与分类 ：将多天 15 秒特征向量取均值平滑瞬态噪声，结合身高（表征动脉路径长度），经逻辑回归模型输出持续高血压概率评分。 为评估其性能，研究团队在全美 5 个临床中心开展了前瞻性、多中心临床试验，纳入 196 名无心血管病史且未服降压药的受试者，并以临床金标准 ——24 小时动态血压监测为参照基准。试验结果显示： 初步筛查 ：特异度达 90.0%，阳性预测值（PPV）为 80.6%，灵敏度为 65.8%（优于门诊单次初筛的 55.3% 灵敏度与 77.8% PPV）。 确诊性检测 （针对初筛偏高人群）：PPV 高达 96.7%，特异度达 90.9%，灵敏度达 78.4%，优于门诊复测，更可比肩需佩戴数天的家庭连续袖带监测。 IT之家获悉，该项研究成果已为谷歌健康应用中的血压趋势“健康守护”功能提供核心技术支撑。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, Google published a blog post on Nov 5 introducing research published in Nature: a multimodal AI system called AI-PPG-ACC-HTN can passively detect signs of hypertension using ordinary consumer smartwatches without cuff calibration. Instead of estimating single-time systolic and diastolic blood pressure, which is easily affected by transient environmental noise, the system aggregates passive physiological features collected over multiple consecutive days to identify an individual's persistent hypertensive state. It uses self-supervised pretraining of a 1D-CNN on more than 490,000 hours of unlabeled data, averages multi-day 15-second feature vectors to smooth transient noise, incorporates height, and uses logistic regression to output a persistent hypertension probability score. The team conducted a prospective, multicenter clinical trial at five U.S. clinical centers with 196 participants who had no cardiovascular history and were not taking antihypertensive drugs, using 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring as the gold standard. Results: initial screening specificity 90.0%, PPV 80.6%, sensitivity 65.8% (better than single clinic screening's 55.3% sensitivity and 77.8% PPV); confirmatory testing PPV 96.7%, specificity 90.9%, sensitivity 78.4%, better than clinic retesting and comparable to multi-day home continuous cuff monitoring. The work provides core technical support for the blood pressure trend “Health Guard” feature in Google's health app.

items.title_zh: 中国科普作家协会发布 2026 年度十大科普热词，AI 相关占据七席
items.title_en: China Science Writers Association releases 2026 top 10 science buzzwords; AI-related terms take seven spots
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，中国科普作家协会今天（7 日）发布了 2026 年度十大科普热词，人工智能相关占据七席，包括 “人工智能 +”“人机协同”“脑机接口”“智能体”“人形机器人”“词元”“具身智能” ，另三大科普热词分别是 “科学玩具”“科技伦理”“健康管理” 。 根据介绍，人工智能相关词汇成为本年度热词的重要组成部分。“人工智能 +”“智能体”“词元”等，反映人工智能 加快融入生产生活带来的新知识需求 ；“脑机接口”“人形机器人”“具身智能”等，为公众 理解前沿技术的原理、进展与应用场景 提供了切入点。 与此同时，“科学玩具”体现科普作品形态的拓展，“人机协同”反映人工智能参与下科普创作的方式变化，“科技伦理”强调技术应用中的责任与价值判断，“健康管理”回应公众对健康知识与科学生活方式的需求。 IT之家附上 2026 年度十大科普热词详细信息如下： NO.01：人工智能 + 以人工智能为核心驱动力，推动人工智能与经济社会各行业各领域广泛深度融合发展，促进生产方式、服务模式和生活方式创新。2025 年，国务院印发《关于深入实施“人工智能 +”行动的意见》，对六大重点行动作出系统部署。2026 年，“人工智能 +”持续深化拓展，在推动技术创新的同时，进一步强调人工智能的规模化应用与实际成效，也对公众理解人工智能、掌握应用方法和识别相关风险提出了新的要求。 NO.02：科学玩具 依据科学技术原理设计，将科学技术知识、原理或方法融入玩乐体验，通过玩耍、观察、实验、测量、建构等一种或多种方式，引导使用者认识相关科学知识、原理或方法，兼具娱乐性和科技教育属性的玩具产品。兼具科学性、趣味性与审美价值，适用于全年龄段群体。2026 年 5 月，中国科普作家协会科学玩具专业委员会成立，推动科学玩具研发、标准建设和产业交流。科学玩具拓展了科普作品的表现形态，也为人们在日常生活中接触科学、体验探究提供了新的载体。 NO.03：人机协同 人类与智能系统通过分工合作、交互反馈和优势互补，共同完成任务的工作方式。人类发挥目标设定、情境理解、价值判断和创造性思考等优势，智能系统提供信息处理、内容生成和自动化执行等支持，协同效果取决于任务分配、过程监督和结果校验。在科普创作中，人机协同可贯穿资料整理、内容构思和多形态表达等环节，同时要求创作者承担科学判断与质量把关责任。 NO.04：脑机接口 在脑与外部设备之间建立直接信息通道，实现脑活动信息与机器指令转换和交互的技术。它不依赖肌肉和外周神经，通过采集、处理和解码脑信号，支持交流沟通、设备控制或康复训练等任务，主要技术路径有侵入式、半侵入式和非侵入式。2026 年，《政府工作报告》将脑机接口列入培育发展的未来产业。作为生命科学与信息科学交叉融合的前沿领域，脑机接口为功能辅助和康复带来新的可能，其实际能力与适用条件仍需持续验证，脑数据隐私保护和应用伦理边界也需进一步明确。 NO.05：智能体 能够感知环境，并利用工具采取行动，以实现特定目标的智能系统。随着大模型技术发展，基于大模型的智能体可以结合任务规划、工具调用和执行反馈，连续完成信息检索、数据处理和流程操作等多步骤任务，具备自主性、交互性、反应性和适应性，是人工智能从被动问答走向自主行动的重要形态。2026 年，《政府工作报告》首次提出“促进新一代智能终端和智能体加快推广”，《中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要》提出鼓励智能体等技术创新。智能体为知识服务和科普互动提供了新的实现路径。 NO.06：人形机器人 一类在外观结构和运动方式上尽量接近人类、能够模仿人类行为的机器人，通常具有与人类相似的躯干、四肢等身体结构。2026 年，北京亦庄继续举办人形机器人半程马拉松比赛，通过复杂赛道中的连续运行，进一步展示和检验了人形机器人的运动控制、环境适应与系统协同能力。从赛场展示到生产生活应用，人形机器人的发展为公众了解机械设计、运动控制和人工智能等技术及其融合应用提供了窗口，也推动社会更加关注其实际能力与应用条件。 NO.07：科技伦理 科技活动中处理人与人、人与社会、人与自然关系应当遵循的价值理念和行为规范，是促进科技事业健康发展、推动科技进步造福社会的重要保障。它贯穿于科学研究、技术研发、成果应用的全过程，强调增进人类福祉、尊重生命权利、…
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, the China Science Writers Association released its 2026 top 10 science popularization buzzwords that day; seven are AI-related: “AI+”, “human-machine collaboration”, “brain-computer interface”, “agent”, “humanoid robot”, “词元 (token)”, and “embodied intelligence”; the other three are “science toys”, “science and technology ethics”, and “health management”. The association said AI-related terms are an important part of this year's buzzwords: “AI+”, “agent” and “词元” reflect new knowledge needs as AI accelerates integration into production and life; “brain-computer interface”, “humanoid robot” and “embodied intelligence” offer entry points for the public to understand the principles, progress and application scenarios of frontier technologies. Meanwhile, “science toys” reflect the expansion of science popularization formats, “human-machine collaboration” reflects changes in science writing with AI participation, “science and technology ethics” emphasizes responsibility and value judgments in technology application, and “health management” responds to public demand for health knowledge and scientific lifestyles. The summary also lists definitions and policy context, including the State Council's opinion on deeply implementing the “AI+” action, the 2026 Government Work Report listing brain-computer interfaces as a future industry to cultivate and proposing for the first time to promote agents and intelligent terminals, the 15th Five-Year Plan outline encouraging agent technology innovation, and the humanoid robot half-marathon in Beijing Yizhuang.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，中国科普作家协会今天（7 日）发布了 2026 年度十大科普热词，人工智能相关占据七席，包括 “人工智能 +”“人机协同”“脑机接口”“智能体”“人形机器人”“词元”“具身智能” ，另三大科普热词分别是 “科学玩具”“科技伦理”“健康管理” 。 根据介绍，人工智能相关词汇成为本年度热词的重要组成部分。“人工智能 +”“智能体”“词元”等，反映人工智能 加快融入生产生活带来的新知识需求 ；“脑机接口”“人形机器人”“具身智能”等，为公众 理解前沿技术的原理、进展与应用场景 提供了切入点。 与此同时，“科学玩具”体现科普作品形态的拓展，“人机协同”反映人工智能参与下科普创作的方式变化，“科技伦理”强调技术应用中的责任与价值判断，“健康管理”回应公众对健康知识与科学生活方式的需求。 IT之家附上 2026 年度十大科普热词详细信息如下： NO.01：人工智能 + 以人工智能为核心驱动力，推动人工智能与经济社会各行业各领域广泛深度融合发展，促进生产方式、服务模式和生活方式创新。2025 年，国务院印发《关于深入实施“人工智能 +”行动的意见》，对六大重点行动作出系统部署。2026 年，“人工智能 +”持续深化拓展，在推动技术创新的同时，进一步强调人工智能的规模化应用与实际成效，也对公众理解人工智能、掌握应用方法和识别相关风险提出了新的要求。 NO.02：科学玩具 依据科学技术原理设计，将科学技术知识、原理或方法融入玩乐体验，通过玩耍、观察、实验、测量、建构等一种或多种方式，引导使用者认识相关科学知识、原理或方法，兼具娱乐性和科技教育属性的玩具产品。兼具科学性、趣味性与审美价值，适用于全年龄段群体。2026 年 5 月，中国科普作家协会科学玩具专业委员会成立，推动科学玩具研发、标准建设和产业交流。科学玩具拓展了科普作品的表现形态，也为人们在日常生活中接触科学、体验探究提供了新的载体。 NO.03：人机协同 人类与智能系统通过分工合作、交互反馈和优势互补，共同完成任务的工作方式。人类发挥目标设定、情境理解、价值判断和创造性思考等优势，智能系统提供信息处理、内容生成和自动化执行等支持，协同效果取决于任务分配、过程监督和结果校验。在科普创作中，人机协同可贯穿资料整理、内容构思和多形态表达等环节，同时要求创作者承担科学判断与质量把关责任。 NO.04：脑机接口 在脑与外部设备之间建立直接信息通道，实现脑活动信息与机器指令转换和交互的技术。它不依赖肌肉和外周神经，通过采集、处理和解码脑信号，支持交流沟通、设备控制或康复训练等任务，主要技术路径有侵入式、半侵入式和非侵入式。2026 年，《政府工作报告》将脑机接口列入培育发展的未来产业。作为生命科学与信息科学交叉融合的前沿领域，脑机接口为功能辅助和康复带来新的可能，其实际能力与适用条件仍需持续验证，脑数据隐私保护和应用伦理边界也需进一步明确。 NO.05：智能体 能够感知环境，并利用工具采取行动，以实现特定目标的智能系统。随着大模型技术发展，基于大模型的智能体可以结合任务规划、工具调用和执行反馈，连续完成信息检索、数据处理和流程操作等多步骤任务，具备自主性、交互性、反应性和适应性，是人工智能从被动问答走向自主行动的重要形态。2026 年，《政府工作报告》首次提出“促进新一代智能终端和智能体加快推广”，《中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要》提出鼓励智能体等技术创新。智能体为知识服务和科普互动提供了新的实现路径。 NO.06：人形机器人 一类在外观结构和运动方式上尽量接近人类、能够模仿人类行为的机器人，通常具有与人类相似的躯干、四肢等身体结构。2026 年，北京亦庄继续举办人形机器人半程马拉松比赛，通过复杂赛道中的连续运行，进一步展示和检验了人形机器人的运动控制、环境适应与系统协同能力。从赛场展示到生产生活应用，人形机器人的发展为公众了解机械设计、运动控制和人工智能等技术及其融合应用提供了窗口，也推动社会更加关注其实际能力与应用条件。 NO.07：科技伦理 科技活动中处理人与人、人与社会、人与自然关系应当遵循的价值理念和行为规范，是促进科技事业健康发展、推动科技进步造福社会的重要保障。它贯穿于科学研究、技术研发、成果应用的全过程，强调增进人类福祉、尊重生命权利、…

items.title_zh: Anthropic 神秘模型“立功”，AI 帮助攻克量子计算领域重大难题
items.title_en: Anthropic unreleased model reportedly helps prove major quantum computing conjecture
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（7 日）上午报道，AI 帮助攻克了量子计算领域一项长期悬而未决的重大难题。 物理研究机构 Physical Superintelligence（PSI）宣布，借助 Anthropic 一款尚未发布的 AI 模型， 量子计算领域的阿伦森－安拜尼斯猜想 成功得到证明。 这项猜想自 2008 年提出以来一直未获证明，研究的是量子计算机 在何种条件下能够获得远超传统计算机的运算速度 。 PSI 自行开发了一套 采用 Anthropic 模型的研究系统 ，仅用三天就完成了证明。据其介绍，此次行动意味着“量子计算领域最根本的问题之一”得到解决。 AI 辅助数学研究取得突破的案例还在增加。今年 9 月，OpenAI 宣布解决了有 90 年历史、“数学前沿最深奥的问题之一”的纳维－斯托克斯方程难题。 证明阿伦森－安拜尼斯猜想的研究系统由 PSI 技术人员戴维 · 图尔图雷安开发，系统使用了 Anthropic 尚未发布的 AI 模型。不过，PSI 具体使用了何种模型暂时不得而知。 证明结果显示，量子计算要实现某些指数级的速度优势，必须依赖问题中存在的特殊规律或结构。这也证实了研究人员长期以来的猜测： 量子计算机并非在所有情况下都能获得巨大的性能优势 。 不过，在部分任务上，量子计算机仍能大幅提升运算性能。需要注意的是，量子计算机虽然已经问世，但技术发展仍处于早期阶段。 此前研究过这一猜想的研究人员称，这是一项“重大成果”， 为存在数十年的难题找到了答案 。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, Business Insider reported that morning that AI helped solve a long-standing major problem in quantum computing. Physical Superintelligence (PSI) announced that, using an unreleased Anthropic AI model, the Aaronson–Ambainis conjecture in quantum computing was successfully proved. Proposed in 2008 and previously unproved, the conjecture studies under what conditions quantum computers can achieve computational speeds far beyond classical computers. PSI developed its own research system using the Anthropic model and completed the proof in just three days; which specific model PSI used is not known. The proof indicates that for quantum computing to achieve certain exponential speedups, problems must rely on special structure or regularity, confirming researchers' long-held suspicion that quantum computers do not always have huge performance advantages; however, on some tasks quantum computers can still greatly improve performance. Researchers who previously studied the conjecture called it a “major result” that found an answer to a decades-old problem. The report also says AI-assisted math breakthroughs are increasing, citing OpenAI's September announcement that it solved the 90-year-old Navier–Stokes problem.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该证明获独立验证，可能显示 AI 辅助数学研究加速，但当前仅为机构声明。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the proof is independently verified, it could indicate that AI-assisted mathematical research is accelerating, but currently this is only an institutional claim.

items.title_zh: AI 已经击穿网络安全行业，接下来会怎样？
items.title_en: AI broke the cybersecurity world. What’s next?
items.summary_zh: 节目对话 Cognition 首席安全官、资深网络安全专家 Alex Stamos，谈当下网络安全局面有多糟。这是探讨“AI 在现实生活中的应用”系列特辑的第一部分。Stamos 直言，我们所熟知的、规模达数十亿美元的网络安全产业，在 AI 助推下不断升级的黑客攻击、入侵与数据泄露面前已难以为继，而这只是 AI 改变安全领域的开端。私人行为体与国家行为体（如俄罗斯、朝鲜）借助 AI 同时发现并利用漏洞，正在入侵各地的系统。Stamos 称，这有一种真正的“边疆”感，就像 90 年代“永远在线”的世界刚出现时一样。如此剧烈的颠覆意味着大量可被入侵的缺口，而其他人只能疲于应对。Stamos 长期而言并非末日论者，但他认为，在设法适应新时代的过程中，我们将经历一段“黑暗时代”。节目还谈到社交网络上的 AI 驱动虚假信息与“垃圾内容”可能如何被管理。节目提示订阅 Decoder 的 YouTube 频道；采访经过轻度编辑。
items.summary_en: Today, I’m talking with Alex Stamos, chief security officer at Cognition and longtime cybersecurity expert, about what a mess cybersecurity is right now. This episode is part one of a special series looking at AI in real life. I’ve always enjoyed talking to Alex because he’s so direct, and you’re going to hear him say that the multibillion-dollar cybersecurity industry as we’ve known it is essentially overdue to the unrelenting, AI-boosted waves of hacks, breaches, and attacks — and this is only the beginning of how much AI is changing security. Verge subscribers, don’t forget you get exclusive access to ad-free Decoder wherever you get your podcasts. Head here . Not a subscriber? You can sign up here . Both private actors and also state actors, like Russia or North Korea, are breaking into systems all over thanks to AI helping them both detect and exploit vulnerabilities all at the same time. It’s got a real frontier feel to it, Alex notes, just like the ’90s, when the whole idea of an always-online world was brand-new. That much disruption means a lot of places where bad guys can get in while everyone else is left scrambling. Alex isn’t a doomer in the long run, but he does think we’re in for a “dark age” while we try to figure out how on earth to adapt to the new era. There’s a lot going on here — we even got all the way to how AI-powered misinformation and slop might be managed on our social networks. items.summary_zh: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers The Verge
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei. | Photo: Jason Henry/Bloomberg via Getty Images Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI. items.summary_zh: 据 The Verge 报道，周二数百万美国选民前往投票站，压倒性地投票支持民主党、反对 AI。报道称，反对大型科技公司的斗争即将强势回归，而对试图建设数据中心的人来说，围绕数据中心的争夺看起来更加艰难。在本期 The Vergecast 中，Nilay 和 David 讨论了 2026 年中期选举对科技行业未来的意义，涉及 X 这一自我隔离式的回音室、国会可能把火力对准科技公司 CEO 与 AI 监管，以及未来两年是否真能有所作为；随后主持人转向 AI 话题。
items.summary_en: On Tuesday, millions of American voters went to the polls and voted overwhelmingly for Democrats and against AI. On this episode of The Vergecast , Nilay and David discuss what the 2026 midterms mean for the tech industry going forward. items.why_zh: 这是媒体对选举结果的解读与评论，若准确，可能预示美国科技监管与数据中心建设将面临更大政治阻力（推测）。
